factors.name: Recent form
factors.note: No recent Tests between these sides to compare; will update once warm-up form is known.

factors.name: Head-to-head
factors.note: South Africa beat Australia in the 2025 World Test Championship final and won the last Test series in South Africa, 3–1 in 2018.

factors.name: Pitch, weather & toss
factors.note: Early-season Durban conditions; forecast to be checked closer to the match.

factors.name: Bowling attack
factors.note: Australia's Test attack is led by Cummins and Hazlewood. SA's depends on who recovers.

factors.name: Spin matchup
factors.note: Australia have struggled against Maharaj and left-arm spin in the ODI series.

factors.name: Key player form
factors.note: To be scored once squads are named.

factors.name: Captain & coach record
factors.note: Both captains have won a World Test Championship final: Cummins in 2023, Bavuma in 2025.

factors.name: Injuries & availability
factors.note: Rabada, Ngidi, Baartman and Maphaka all have hamstring injuries; their Test availability is unclear.

factors.name: Motivation & rotation
factors.note: World Test Championship points at stake for both sides.

players.stats: Key wickets throughout the ODI series
players.achievement: Australia's batters have not found an answer to him.
players.concern: Durban pitches often help seam more than spin early on.
Leading a side missing several fast bowlers.

players.stats: Played only two of Australia's last 31 ODIs
players.achievement: Won the 2023 World Test Championship and 2023 World Cup as captain.
Match-winning hundreds in the 2023 WTC and World Cup finals.
players.concern: Australia's batting has struggled against spin on this tour.

leaders.achievement: Led South Africa to the 2023–25 World Test Championship title against Australia.
leaders.concern: Fast-bowling depth is badly hit by injuries.

leaders.achievement: Coached SA to the 2023–25 World Test Championship title.
leaders.concern: Eight Tests in four months will test the squad's depth.

leaders.achievement: 2023 World Test Championship and 2023 World Cup winner.
leaders.concern: Lost the 2025 World Test Championship final to South Africa.

leaders.achievement: Coached Australia to the 2023 World Test Championship and World Cup.
leaders.concern: Australia lost the 2025 World Test Championship final to South Africa.

fixtures.why: South Africa get a narrow edge from home advantage and Maharaj's left-arm spin, which Australia's batters have struggled with on this tour. Provisional until squads are named.
fixtures.swing: Australia's Test pace attack is stronger than South Africa's injury-hit one. If Rabada and the other injured quicks are not fit, Australia could become favourites.
